SELECT organization_id,
    maintenance_item_id,
    current_stock,
    minimum_stock_level,
    last_purchase_cost
   FROM maintenance_item_stock_summary
  WHERE current_stock <= minimum_stock_level;

SELECT mi.organization_id,
    mi.id AS maintenance_item_id,
    COALESCE(sum(se.quantity_available), 0::numeric) AS current_stock,
    mi.minimum_stock_level,
    max(se.purchase_cost_per_unit) FILTER (WHERE se.purchased_on IS NOT NULL) AS last_purchase_cost
   FROM maintenance_items mi
     LEFT JOIN maintenance_item_stock_entries se ON se.maintenance_item_id = mi.id AND se.organization_id = mi.organization_id
  GROUP BY mi.organization_id, mi.id, mi.minimum_stock_level;

SELECT je.organization_id,
    je.entry_date,
    je.period,
    je.id AS journal_entry_id,
    je.source_table,
    je.source_id,
    je.is_reversal_of,
    a.id AS account_id,
    a.code AS account_code,
    a.name AS account_name,
    a.account_type,
    a.normal_balance,
    parent.code AS parent_code,
    parent.name AS parent_name,
    jl.party_kind,
    jl.party_id,
    jl.allotment_id,
    jl.property_id,
    jl.apartment_id,
    jl.bed_id,
    jl.debit,
    jl.credit,
        CASE a.normal_balance
            WHEN 'DEBIT'::normal_balance THEN jl.debit - jl.credit
            WHEN 'CREDIT'::normal_balance THEN jl.credit - jl.debit
            ELSE NULL::numeric
        END AS signed_amount
   FROM journal_lines jl
     JOIN journal_entries je ON je.id = jl.journal_entry_id
     JOIN coa_accounts a ON a.id = jl.account_id
     LEFT JOIN coa_accounts parent ON parent.id = a.parent_id
  WHERE je.is_reversal_of IS NULL AND NOT (EXISTS ( SELECT 1
           FROM journal_entries r
          WHERE r.is_reversal_of = je.id));

WITH RECURSIVE descendants AS (
         SELECT coa_accounts.id AS root_id,
            coa_accounts.id AS descendant_id,
            coa_accounts.organization_id
           FROM coa_accounts
        UNION ALL
         SELECT d_1.root_id,
            c.id,
            c.organization_id
           FROM descendants d_1
             JOIN coa_accounts c ON c.parent_id = d_1.descendant_id
        ), balances AS (
         SELECT journal_lines.account_id,
            journal_lines.organization_id,
            sum(journal_lines.debit) AS total_debit,
            sum(journal_lines.credit) AS total_credit
           FROM journal_lines
          GROUP BY journal_lines.account_id, journal_lines.organization_id
        )
 SELECT a.organization_id,
    a.id AS account_id,
    a.code,
    a.name,
    a.account_type,
    a.normal_balance,
    a.parent_id,
    COALESCE(sum(b.total_debit), 0::numeric) AS total_debit_rollup,
    COALESCE(sum(b.total_credit), 0::numeric) AS total_credit_rollup,
        CASE a.normal_balance
            WHEN 'DEBIT'::normal_balance THEN COALESCE(sum(b.total_debit), 0::numeric) - COALESCE(sum(b.total_credit), 0::numeric)
            ELSE COALESCE(sum(b.total_credit), 0::numeric) - COALESCE(sum(b.total_debit), 0::numeric)
        END AS balance_rollup
   FROM coa_accounts a
     LEFT JOIN descendants d ON d.root_id = a.id AND d.organization_id = a.organization_id
     LEFT JOIN balances b ON b.account_id = d.descendant_id AND b.organization_id = d.organization_id
  GROUP BY a.organization_id, a.id, a.code, a.name, a.account_type, a.normal_balance, a.parent_id;

SELECT organization_id,
    property_id,
    count(DISTINCT tenant_id) FILTER (WHERE staying_status = ANY (ARRAY['Staying'::staying_status, 'On-Notice'::staying_status])) AS active_tenants,
    count(DISTINCT tenant_id) FILTER (WHERE staying_status = 'Booked'::staying_status) AS booked_tenants,
    count(DISTINCT tenant_id) AS total_tenants_ever
   FROM tenant_allotments a
  GROUP BY organization_id, property_id;

SELECT organization_id,
    party_id AS tenant_id,
    allotment_id,
    sum(
        CASE
            WHEN account_code = '2100'::text THEN signed_amount
            ELSE 0::numeric
        END) AS deposit_held,
    sum(
        CASE
            WHEN account_code = '2400'::text THEN signed_amount
            ELSE 0::numeric
        END) AS booking_advance
   FROM v_account_balances
  WHERE (account_code = ANY (ARRAY['2100'::text, '2400'::text])) AND party_kind = 'tenant'::party_kind
  GROUP BY organization_id, party_id, allotment_id;

WITH purchase_totals AS (
         SELECT a.id AS asset_id,
            a.organization_id,
            a.asset_code,
            a.purchase_price,
            a.supplier_id,
            a.invoice_number,
            a.invoice_date,
            a.purchase_date
           FROM assets a
          WHERE a.purchase_price IS NOT NULL AND a.purchase_price > 0::numeric
        ), payments_totals AS (
         SELECT ap.asset_id,
            sum(ap.amount) AS total_paid,
            count(*) AS payment_count,
            max(ap.payment_date) AS last_payment_date
           FROM asset_payments ap
          GROUP BY ap.asset_id
        )
 SELECT pt.asset_id,
    pt.organization_id,
    pt.asset_code,
    pt.invoice_number,
    pt.invoice_date,
    pt.purchase_date,
    pt.purchase_price,
    pt.supplier_id,
    v.vendor_name,
    COALESCE(p.total_paid, 0::numeric) AS total_paid,
    pt.purchase_price - COALESCE(p.total_paid, 0::numeric) AS balance_due,
    COALESCE(p.payment_count, 0::bigint) AS payment_count,
    p.last_payment_date,
        CASE
            WHEN COALESCE(p.total_paid, 0::numeric) <= 0::numeric THEN 'unpaid'::text
            WHEN COALESCE(p.total_paid, 0::numeric) >= pt.purchase_price THEN 'paid'::text
            ELSE 'partial'::text
        END AS status
   FROM purchase_totals pt
     LEFT JOIN payments_totals p ON p.asset_id = pt.asset_id
     LEFT JOIN vendors v ON v.id = pt.supplier_id;

SELECT organization_id,
    bed_id,
    apartment_id,
    property_id,
    date_trunc('month'::text, entry_date::timestamp with time zone)::date AS month,
    account_code AS category_code,
    account_name AS category_name,
    sum(signed_amount) AS amount
   FROM v_account_balances
  WHERE account_type = 'EXPENSE'::account_type AND bed_id IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY organization_id, bed_id, apartment_id, property_id, (date_trunc('month'::text, entry_date::timestamp with time zone)::date), account_code, account_name;

WITH premature AS (
         SELECT ds.organization_id,
            ds.tenant_id,
            ds.allotment_id,
            ds.id AS settlement_id,
            'premature_settlement'::text AS anomaly,
            format('deductions=₹%s on allotment with status=%s, actual_exit_date=%s'::text, round(COALESCE(ds.total_deductions, 0::numeric))::text, COALESCE(ta.staying_status::text, 'unknown'::text), COALESCE(ta.actual_exit_date::text, 'NULL'::text)) AS details
           FROM deposit_settlements ds
             JOIN tenant_allotments ta ON ta.id = ds.allotment_id
          WHERE COALESCE(ds.is_deleted, false) = false AND COALESCE(ds.total_deductions, 0::numeric) > 0::numeric AND ta.actual_exit_date IS NULL AND (ta.staying_status::text <> ALL (ARRAY['Exited'::text, 'Cancelled'::text]))
        ), dupes AS (
         SELECT ds.organization_id,
            ds.tenant_id,
            ds.allotment_id,
            NULL::uuid AS settlement_id,
            'duplicate_open_settlement'::text AS anomaly,
            format('open settlements on this allotment: %s'::text, count(*)) AS details
           FROM deposit_settlements ds
          WHERE COALESCE(ds.is_deleted, false) = false AND COALESCE(ds.status, ''::text) <> 'completed'::text AND ds.allotment_id IS NOT NULL
          GROUP BY ds.organization_id, ds.tenant_id, ds.allotment_id
         HAVING count(*) > 1
        ), deposit_per_allot AS (
         SELECT jl.party_id AS tenant_id,
            jl.allotment_id,
            sum(jl.credit) - sum(jl.debit) AS net_deposit
           FROM journal_lines jl
             JOIN journal_entries je ON je.id = jl.journal_entry_id
             JOIN coa_accounts a ON a.id = jl.account_id
          WHERE jl.party_kind = 'tenant'::party_kind AND (a.code = ANY (ARRAY['2100'::text, '2400'::text])) AND je.is_reversal_of IS NULL AND NOT (EXISTS ( SELECT 1
                   FROM journal_entries rev
                  WHERE rev.is_reversal_of = je.id)) AND jl.allotment_id IS NOT NULL
          GROUP BY jl.party_id, jl.allotment_id
         HAVING (sum(jl.credit) - sum(jl.debit)) > 0::numeric
        ), double_count AS (
         SELECT ta.organization_id,
            dpa.tenant_id,
            dpa.allotment_id,
            NULL::uuid AS settlement_id,
            'transfer_double_count'::text AS anomaly,
            format('this allotment holds ₹%s deposit; same tenant has %s other allotment(s) holding ₹%s combined'::text, round(dpa.net_deposit)::text, ( SELECT count(*) - 1
                   FROM deposit_per_allot d2
                  WHERE d2.tenant_id = dpa.tenant_id), ( SELECT round(COALESCE(sum(d3.net_deposit) - dpa.net_deposit, 0::numeric))::text AS round
                   FROM deposit_per_allot d3
                  WHERE d3.tenant_id = dpa.tenant_id)) AS details
           FROM deposit_per_allot dpa
             JOIN tenant_allotments ta ON ta.id = dpa.allotment_id
          WHERE (EXISTS ( SELECT 1
                   FROM deposit_per_allot d2
                  WHERE d2.tenant_id = dpa.tenant_id AND d2.allotment_id <> dpa.allotment_id))
        )
 SELECT premature.organization_id,
    premature.tenant_id,
    premature.allotment_id,
    premature.settlement_id,
    premature.anomaly,
    premature.details
   FROM premature
UNION ALL
 SELECT dupes.organization_id,
    dupes.tenant_id,
    dupes.allotment_id,
    dupes.settlement_id,
    dupes.anomaly,
    dupes.details
   FROM dupes
UNION ALL
 SELECT double_count.organization_id,
    double_count.tenant_id,
    double_count.allotment_id,
    double_count.settlement_id,
    double_count.anomaly,
    double_count.details
   FROM double_count;

WITH agg AS (
         SELECT tenant_transactions.allotment_id,
            sum(
                CASE
                    WHEN tenant_transactions.direction = 'DEBIT'::text THEN tenant_transactions.amount
                    ELSE 0::numeric
                END) - sum(
                CASE
                    WHEN tenant_transactions.direction = 'CREDIT'::text THEN tenant_transactions.amount
                    ELSE 0::numeric
                END) AS computed_balance
           FROM tenant_transactions
          WHERE tenant_transactions.ledger_type = ANY (ARRAY['CHARGE'::text, 'PAYMENT'::text])
          GROUP BY tenant_transactions.allotment_id
        )
 SELECT a.id AS allotment_id,
    a.organization_id,
    a.balance_due AS stored_balance,
    GREATEST(agg.computed_balance, 0::numeric) AS computed_balance,
    a.balance_due - GREATEST(agg.computed_balance, 0::numeric) AS drift
   FROM tenant_allotments a
     JOIN agg ON agg.allotment_id = a.id
  WHERE abs(a.balance_due - GREATEST(agg.computed_balance, 0::numeric)) > 1.00;

SELECT organization_id,
    id AS allotment_id,
    tenant_id,
    deposit_paid,
    staying_status,
    actual_exit_date,
    'Deposit held with no live tenant relationship'::text AS note
   FROM tenant_allotments a
  WHERE COALESCE(deposit_paid, 0::numeric) > 0::numeric AND (staying_status = ANY (ARRAY['Exited'::staying_status, 'Cancelled'::staying_status])) AND NOT (EXISTS ( SELECT 1
           FROM deposit_settlements ds
          WHERE ds.allotment_id = a.id AND COALESCE(ds.is_deleted, false) = false));

SELECT organization_id,
    id AS invoice_id,
    invoice_number,
    billing_month,
    total_amount,
    amount_paid,
    balance,
    total_amount - amount_paid - balance AS drift,
    status
   FROM invoices
  WHERE NOT COALESCE(is_deleted, false) AND abs(COALESCE(total_amount, 0::numeric) - COALESCE(amount_paid, 0::numeric) - COALESCE(balance, 0::numeric)) > 0.01;

SELECT organization_id,
    id AS receipt_id,
    tenant_id,
    payment_date,
    amount_paid,
    receipt_type,
    receipt_number
   FROM receipts
  WHERE NOT COALESCE(is_deleted, false) AND tenant_allotment_id IS NULL;

SELECT organization_id,
    date_trunc('month'::text, COALESCE(paid_date, due_date)::timestamp with time zone)::date AS month,
    sum(escalated_amount) AS owner_rent_paid_or_accrued,
    'Currently NOT included in get_universal_metrics.totalProfit'::text AS note
   FROM owner_payments op
  WHERE status = ANY (ARRAY['paid'::text, 'pending'::text])
  GROUP BY organization_id, (date_trunc('month'::text, COALESCE(paid_date, due_date)::timestamp with time zone)::date);

SELECT ta.organization_id,
    ta.tenant_id,
    ta.id AS allotment_id,
    ta.property_id,
    ta.apartment_id,
    ta.bed_id,
    t.full_name AS tenant_name,
    p.property_name,
    ap.apartment_code,
    b.bed_code,
    (ap.apartment_code || '-'::text) || b.bed_code AS bed_label,
    ta.actual_exit_date,
    COALESCE(cd.ar_balance, 0::numeric) AS dues_now,
    COALESCE(cd.deposit_held, 0::numeric) + COALESCE(cd.booking_advance, 0::numeric) AS deposit_held,
    COALESCE(eb.eb_already, 0::numeric) AS eb_already,
    COALESCE(ec.exit_charge_already, 0::numeric) AS exit_charge_already,
    ds.status AS settlement_status
   FROM tenant_allotments ta
     JOIN tenants t ON t.id = ta.tenant_id
     JOIN apartments ap ON ap.id = ta.apartment_id
     JOIN beds b ON b.id = ta.bed_id
     JOIN properties p ON p.id = ta.property_id
     LEFT JOIN v_tenant_current_dues cd ON cd.allotment_id = ta.id
     LEFT JOIN LATERAL ( SELECT sum(i.total_amount) AS eb_already
           FROM invoices i
          WHERE i.allotment_id = ta.id AND i.reference_type = 'exit_estimated_eb'::text AND COALESCE(i.is_deleted, false) = false) eb ON true
     LEFT JOIN LATERAL ( SELECT sum(i.total_amount) AS exit_charge_already
           FROM invoices i
          WHERE i.allotment_id = ta.id AND i.invoice_type = 'exit_charge'::text AND COALESCE(i.is_deleted, false) = false) ec ON true
     LEFT JOIN LATERAL ( SELECT ds2.status
           FROM deposit_settlements ds2
          WHERE ds2.allotment_id = ta.id AND COALESCE(ds2.is_deleted, false) = false
          ORDER BY ds2.created_at DESC NULLS LAST
         LIMIT 1) ds ON true
  WHERE ta.staying_status = 'Exited'::staying_status AND (COALESCE(cd.ar_balance, 0::numeric) <> 0::numeric OR (COALESCE(cd.deposit_held, 0::numeric) + COALESCE(cd.booking_advance, 0::numeric)) > 0::numeric);

WITH base AS (
         SELECT v_account_balances.organization_id,
            v_account_balances.property_id,
            date_trunc('month'::text, v_account_balances.entry_date::timestamp with time zone)::date AS month,
            COALESCE(v_account_balances.parent_code, v_account_balances.account_code) AS category_code,
            COALESCE(v_account_balances.parent_name, v_account_balances.account_name) AS category_name,
            v_account_balances.account_code,
            v_account_balances.account_name,
            sum(v_account_balances.signed_amount) AS amount
           FROM v_account_balances
          WHERE v_account_balances.account_type = 'EXPENSE'::account_type
          GROUP BY v_account_balances.organization_id, v_account_balances.property_id, (date_trunc('month'::text, v_account_balances.entry_date::timestamp with time zone)::date), (COALESCE(v_account_balances.parent_code, v_account_balances.account_code)), (COALESCE(v_account_balances.parent_name, v_account_balances.account_name)), v_account_balances.account_code, v_account_balances.account_name
        )
 SELECT organization_id,
    property_id,
    month,
    category_code,
    category_name,
    account_code,
    account_name,
    amount,
    round(100.0 * amount / NULLIF(sum(amount) OVER (PARTITION BY organization_id, property_id, month, category_code), 0::numeric), 2) AS pct_of_category,
    round(100.0 * amount / NULLIF(sum(amount) OVER (PARTITION BY organization_id, property_id, month), 0::numeric), 2) AS pct_of_total
   FROM base;

SELECT organization_id,
    property_id,
    date_trunc('month'::text, entry_date::timestamp with time zone)::date AS month,
    account_code,
    account_name,
    sum(signed_amount) AS expense
   FROM v_account_balances
  WHERE account_type = 'EXPENSE'::account_type
  GROUP BY organization_id, property_id, (date_trunc('month'::text, entry_date::timestamp with time zone)::date), account_code, account_name;

SELECT id,
    organization_id,
    table_name,
    record_id,
    action,
    performed_at AS created_at,
    performed_by AS created_by,
    _export_profile_name(performed_by) AS created_by_name,
    performed_at AS updated_at,

    _export_profile_name(performed_by) AS updated_by_name,
    old_value,
    new_value,
    changes,
    NULL::text AS status,

SELECT b.id,
    b.organization_id,
    a.property_id,
    pr.property_name,
    b.apartment_id,
    a.apartment_code,
    b.bed_code,
    b.bed_type::text AS bed_type,
    b.toilet_type::text AS toilet_type,
    b.status::text AS status,
    b.bed_lifecycle_status,

    NULL::timestamp with time zone AS updated_at,

   FROM beds b

     LEFT JOIN properties pr ON pr.id = a.property_id;

SELECT ds.id,
    ds.organization_id,
    ds.tenant_id,
    tn.full_name AS tenant_name,
    ds.allotment_id,
    ds.settlement_date,
    ds.deposit_amount,
    ds.pending_rent,
    ds.pending_eb,
    ds.pending_late_fees,
    ds.damages,
    ds.other_deductions,
    ds.total_deductions,
    ds.refund_amount,
    ds.status,
    ds.notes,
    ds.is_deleted,
    ds.created_at,
    NULL::timestamp with time zone AS updated_at,
    NULL::uuid AS created_by,
    NULL::text AS created_by_name,
    NULL::uuid AS updated_by,
    NULL::text AS updated_by_name
   FROM deposit_settlements ds
     LEFT JOIN tenants tn ON tn.id = ds.tenant_id;

SELECT er.id,
    er.organization_id,
    er.property_id,
    pr.property_name,
    er.apartment_id,
    apt.apartment_code,
    er.billing_month,
    er.reading_start,
    er.reading_end,
    er.units_consumed,
    er.unit_cost,
    COALESCE(er.units_consumed, er.reading_end - er.reading_start) * er.unit_cost AS total_amount,
    er.meter_photo_url,
    er.is_locked,
    er.locked_by,
    _export_profile_name(er.locked_by) AS locked_by_name,
    er.created_at,
    NULL::timestamp with time zone AS updated_at,
    er.locked_by AS created_by,
    _export_profile_name(er.locked_by) AS created_by_name,
    NULL::uuid AS updated_by,
    NULL::text AS updated_by_name,
        CASE
            WHEN er.is_locked THEN 'locked'::text
            ELSE 'open'::text
        END AS status,
    NULL::uuid AS tenant_id
   FROM electricity_readings er
     LEFT JOIN properties pr ON pr.id = er.property_id
     LEFT JOIN apartments apt ON apt.id = er.apartment_id;

    e.property_id,

    apt.apartment_code,
    e.bed_id,
    bd.bed_code,
    e.category_id,
    ec.label AS category_label,
    e.subcategory_id,
    esc.label AS subcategory_label,
    e.vendor_id,
    v.vendor_name,

    e.description,

    e.receipt_url,
    e.related_asset_id,
    e.ticket_resolution_id,
    e.created_at,
    NULL::timestamp with time zone AS updated_at,
    NULL::uuid AS created_by,
    NULL::text AS created_by_name,
    NULL::uuid AS updated_by,
    NULL::text AS updated_by_name,
    NULL::text AS status
   FROM expenses e
     LEFT JOIN properties pr ON pr.id = e.property_id
     LEFT JOIN apartments apt ON apt.id = e.apartment_id
     LEFT JOIN beds bd ON bd.id = e.bed_id
     LEFT JOIN expense_categories ec ON ec.id = e.category_id
     LEFT JOIN expense_subcategories esc ON esc.id = e.subcategory_id
     LEFT JOIN vendors v ON v.id = e.vendor_id;

     LEFT JOIN apartments apt ON apt.id = i.apartment_id
     LEFT JOIN beds bd ON bd.id = i.bed_id;

SELECT id,
    organization_id,
    entry_date,
    period,
    source_table,
    source_id,

WITH ar_lines AS (
         SELECT jl.organization_id,
            jl.party_id AS tenant_id,
            jl.allotment_id,
            je.id AS journal_entry_id,
            je.source_table,
            je.source_id,
            je.entry_date,
            je.posted_at,
            jl.line_no,
            jl.debit,
            jl.credit
           FROM journal_lines jl
             JOIN journal_entries je ON je.id = jl.journal_entry_id
             JOIN coa_accounts a ON a.id = jl.account_id
          WHERE a.code = '1200'::text AND jl.party_kind = 'tenant'::party_kind
        ), ranked AS (
         SELECT ar_lines.organization_id,
            ar_lines.tenant_id,
            ar_lines.allotment_id,
            ar_lines.journal_entry_id,
            ar_lines.source_table,
            ar_lines.source_id,
            ar_lines.entry_date,
            ar_lines.posted_at,
            ar_lines.line_no,
            ar_lines.debit,
            ar_lines.credit,
            sum(ar_lines.debit) OVER w AS cum_debit,
            sum(ar_lines.credit) OVER w AS cum_credit
           FROM ar_lines
          WINDOW w AS (PARTITION BY ar_lines.organization_id, ar_lines.tenant_id, ar_lines.allotment_id ORDER BY ar_lines.entry_date, ar_lines.posted_at, ar_lines.line_no ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW)
        ), charges AS (
         SELECT ranked.organization_id,
            ranked.tenant_id,
            ranked.allotment_id,
            ranked.journal_entry_id,
            ranked.source_table,
            ranked.source_id,
            ranked.entry_date,
            ranked.posted_at,
            ranked.line_no,
            ranked.debit,
            ranked.credit,
            ranked.cum_debit,
            ranked.cum_credit,
            ranked.cum_debit - ranked.debit AS prior_debit,
            ranked.cum_debit AS through_debit,
            ( SELECT max(r2.cum_credit) AS max
                   FROM ranked r2
                  WHERE r2.organization_id = ranked.organization_id AND r2.tenant_id = ranked.tenant_id AND r2.allotment_id = ranked.allotment_id) AS total_credits
           FROM ranked
          WHERE ranked.debit > 0::numeric
        )
 SELECT organization_id,
    tenant_id,
    allotment_id,
    source_table,
    source_id AS invoice_id,
    entry_date AS invoice_date,
    debit AS invoice_amount,
    GREATEST(0::numeric, LEAST(debit, COALESCE(total_credits, 0::numeric) - prior_debit)) AS amount_settled,
    debit - GREATEST(0::numeric, LEAST(debit, COALESCE(total_credits, 0::numeric) - prior_debit)) AS amount_outstanding,
        CASE
            WHEN (debit - GREATEST(0::numeric, LEAST(debit, COALESCE(total_credits, 0::numeric) - prior_debit))) <= 0.01 THEN 'paid'::text
            WHEN GREATEST(0::numeric, LEAST(debit, COALESCE(total_credits, 0::numeric) - prior_debit)) > 0::numeric THEN 'partial'::text
            ELSE 'unpaid'::text
        END AS settlement_status
   FROM charges
  WHERE source_table = 'invoices'::text;

WITH inv AS (
         SELECT 'invoices'::text AS src,
            ( SELECT COALESCE(sum(invoices.total_amount), 0::numeric) AS "coalesce"
                   FROM invoices
                  WHERE COALESCE(invoices.is_deleted, false) = false) AS legacy_amount,
            ( SELECT COALESCE(sum(
                        CASE
                            WHEN je.is_reversal_of IS NULL THEN jl.debit
                            ELSE - jl.debit
                        END), 0::numeric) AS "coalesce"
                   FROM journal_entries je
                     JOIN journal_lines jl ON jl.journal_entry_id = je.id
                     JOIN coa_accounts a ON a.id = jl.account_id
                  WHERE je.source_table = 'invoices'::text AND a.account_type = 'ASSET'::account_type) AS je_net_amount
        ), rcp AS (
         SELECT 'receipts'::text AS "?column?",
            ( SELECT COALESCE(sum(receipts.amount_paid), 0::numeric) AS "coalesce"
                   FROM receipts
                  WHERE COALESCE(receipts.is_deleted, false) = false) AS "coalesce",
            ( SELECT COALESCE(sum(
                        CASE
                            WHEN je.is_reversal_of IS NULL THEN jl.debit
                            ELSE - jl.debit
                        END), 0::numeric) AS "coalesce"
                   FROM journal_entries je
                     JOIN journal_lines jl ON jl.journal_entry_id = je.id
                     JOIN coa_accounts a ON a.id = jl.account_id
                  WHERE je.source_table = 'receipts'::text AND a.account_type = 'ASSET'::account_type AND a.code ~~ '11%'::text) AS "coalesce"
        ), exp AS (
         SELECT 'expenses'::text AS "?column?",
            ( SELECT COALESCE(sum(expenses.amount), 0::numeric) AS "coalesce"
                   FROM expenses) AS "coalesce",
            ( SELECT COALESCE(sum(
                        CASE
                            WHEN je.is_reversal_of IS NULL THEN jl.debit
                            ELSE - jl.debit
                        END), 0::numeric) AS "coalesce"
                   FROM journal_entries je
                     JOIN journal_lines jl ON jl.journal_entry_id = je.id
                     JOIN coa_accounts a ON a.id = jl.account_id
                  WHERE je.source_table = 'expenses'::text AND a.account_type = 'EXPENSE'::account_type) AS "coalesce"
        ), op AS (
         SELECT 'owner_payments'::text AS "?column?",
            ( SELECT COALESCE(sum(COALESCE(owner_payments.escalated_amount, owner_payments.base_amount)), 0::numeric) AS "coalesce"
                   FROM owner_payments) AS "coalesce",
            ( SELECT COALESCE(sum(
                        CASE
                            WHEN je.is_reversal_of IS NULL THEN jl.debit
                            ELSE - jl.debit
                        END), 0::numeric) AS "coalesce"
                   FROM journal_entries je
                     JOIN journal_lines jl ON jl.journal_entry_id = je.id
                     JOIN coa_accounts a ON a.id = jl.account_id
                  WHERE je.source_table = 'owner_payments'::text AND a.account_type = 'EXPENSE'::account_type) AS "coalesce"
        ), adj AS (
         SELECT 'tenant_adjustments'::text AS "?column?",
            ( SELECT COALESCE(sum(tenant_adjustments.amount), 0::numeric) AS "coalesce"
                   FROM tenant_adjustments
                  WHERE COALESCE(tenant_adjustments.is_deleted, false) = false) AS "coalesce",
            ( SELECT COALESCE(sum(
                        CASE
                            WHEN je.is_reversal_of IS NULL THEN GREATEST(jl.debit, jl.credit)
                            ELSE - GREATEST(jl.debit, jl.credit)
                        END) / 2::numeric, 0::numeric) AS "coalesce"
                   FROM journal_entries je
                     JOIN journal_lines jl ON jl.journal_entry_id = je.id
                  WHERE je.source_table = 'tenant_adjustments'::text) AS "coalesce"
        ), ds AS (
         SELECT 'deposit_settlements'::text AS "?column?",
            ( SELECT COALESCE(sum(deposit_settlements.refund_amount), 0::numeric) AS "coalesce"
                   FROM deposit_settlements
                  WHERE COALESCE(deposit_settlements.is_deleted, false) = false) AS "coalesce",
            ( SELECT COALESCE(sum(
                        CASE
                            WHEN je.is_reversal_of IS NULL THEN jl.credit
                            ELSE - jl.credit
                        END), 0::numeric) AS "coalesce"
                   FROM journal_entries je
                     JOIN journal_lines jl ON jl.journal_entry_id = je.id
                     JOIN coa_accounts a ON a.id = jl.account_id
                  WHERE je.source_table = 'deposit_settlements'::text AND a.account_type = 'ASSET'::account_type AND a.code ~~ '11%'::text) AS "coalesce"
        )
 SELECT src AS source_table,
    legacy_amount::numeric(16,2) AS legacy_amount,
    je_net_amount::numeric(16,2) AS je_net_amount,
    (je_net_amount - legacy_amount)::numeric(16,2) AS diff,
        CASE
            WHEN abs(je_net_amount - legacy_amount) < 0.50 THEN 'PERFECT'::text
            WHEN (abs(je_net_amount - legacy_amount) / NULLIF(legacy_amount, 0::numeric)) < 0.001 THEN 'WITHIN_TOLERANCE'::text
            ELSE 'INVESTIGATE'::text
        END AS verdict
   FROM ( SELECT inv.src,
            inv.legacy_amount,
            inv.je_net_amount
           FROM inv
        UNION ALL
         SELECT rcp."?column?",
            rcp."coalesce",
            rcp.coalesce_1 AS "coalesce"
           FROM rcp rcp("?column?", "coalesce", coalesce_1)
        UNION ALL
         SELECT exp."?column?",
            exp."coalesce",
            exp.coalesce_1 AS "coalesce"
           FROM exp exp("?column?", "coalesce", coalesce_1)
        UNION ALL
         SELECT op."?column?",
            op."coalesce",
            op.coalesce_1 AS "coalesce"
           FROM op op("?column?", "coalesce", coalesce_1)
        UNION ALL
         SELECT adj."?column?",
            adj."coalesce",
            adj.coalesce_1 AS "coalesce"
           FROM adj adj("?column?", "coalesce", coalesce_1)
        UNION ALL
         SELECT ds."?column?",
            ds."coalesce",
            ds.coalesce_1 AS "coalesce"
           FROM ds ds("?column?", "coalesce", coalesce_1)) z
  ORDER BY src;

WITH src AS (

            ( SELECT count(*) AS count
                   FROM invoices
                  WHERE COALESCE(invoices.is_deleted, false) = false) AS legacy_live,
            ( SELECT count(*) AS count
                   FROM invoices) AS legacy_total
        UNION ALL
         SELECT 'receipts'::text,
            ( SELECT count(*) AS count
                   FROM receipts
                  WHERE COALESCE(receipts.is_deleted, false) = false) AS count,
            ( SELECT count(*) AS count
                   FROM receipts) AS count
        UNION ALL
         SELECT 'expenses'::text,
            ( SELECT count(*) AS count
                   FROM expenses) AS count,
            ( SELECT count(*) AS count
                   FROM expenses) AS count
        UNION ALL
         SELECT 'tenant_transactions'::text,
            ( SELECT count(*) AS count
                   FROM tenant_transactions) AS count,
            ( SELECT count(*) AS count
                   FROM tenant_transactions) AS count
        UNION ALL
         SELECT 'tenant_adjustments'::text,
            ( SELECT count(*) AS count
                   FROM tenant_adjustments
                  WHERE COALESCE(tenant_adjustments.is_deleted, false) = false) AS count,
            ( SELECT count(*) AS count
                   FROM tenant_adjustments) AS count
        UNION ALL
         SELECT 'deposit_settlements'::text,
            ( SELECT count(*) AS count
                   FROM deposit_settlements
                  WHERE COALESCE(deposit_settlements.is_deleted, false) = false) AS count,
            ( SELECT count(*) AS count
                   FROM deposit_settlements) AS count
        UNION ALL
         SELECT 'owner_payments'::text,
            ( SELECT count(*) AS count
                   FROM owner_payments) AS count,
            ( SELECT count(*) AS count
                   FROM owner_payments) AS count
        ), je AS (
         SELECT journal_entries.source_table AS src,
            count(*) FILTER (WHERE journal_entries.is_reversal_of IS NULL) AS je_forward,
            count(*) FILTER (WHERE journal_entries.is_reversal_of IS NOT NULL) AS je_reversal,
            count(DISTINCT journal_entries.source_id) FILTER (WHERE journal_entries.is_reversal_of IS NULL) AS distinct_forward_sources
           FROM journal_entries
          GROUP BY journal_entries.source_table
        )
 SELECT s.src AS source_table,
    s.legacy_live,
    s.legacy_total,
    COALESCE(j.je_forward, 0::bigint) AS je_forward,
    COALESCE(j.je_reversal, 0::bigint) AS je_reversal,
    COALESCE(j.distinct_forward_sources, 0::bigint) AS je_distinct_sources,
    s.legacy_live - COALESCE(j.distinct_forward_sources, 0::bigint) AS gap_live_minus_je
   FROM src s
     LEFT JOIN je j ON j.src = s.src
  ORDER BY s.src;

   FROM ( SELECT je_1.id,

                   FROM journal_lines jl
                  WHERE jl.journal_entry_id = je_1.id) AS jl_cnt

           FROM beds b

          WHERE b.status = 'Live'::entity_status AND ap.status = 'Live'::entity_status
        ), state AS (
         SELECT b.organization_id,
            b.property_id,
            b.id AS bed_id,
            (EXISTS ( SELECT 1
                   FROM tenant_allotments a
                  WHERE a.bed_id = b.id AND a.staying_status = 'Staying'::staying_status)) AS occupied,
            (EXISTS ( SELECT 1
                   FROM tenant_allotments a
                  WHERE a.bed_id = b.id AND a.staying_status = 'Booked'::staying_status)) AS booked,
            (EXISTS ( SELECT 1
                   FROM tenant_allotments a
                  WHERE a.bed_id = b.id AND a.staying_status = 'On-Notice'::staying_status)) AS on_notice
           FROM live_beds b
        )
 SELECT organization_id,
    property_id,
    count(*) AS total_beds,
    count(*) FILTER (WHERE occupied) AS occupied,
    count(*) FILTER (WHERE on_notice AND occupied) AS on_notice,
    count(*) FILTER (WHERE NOT occupied AND booked) AS booked,
    count(*) FILTER (WHERE NOT occupied AND NOT booked AND NOT on_notice) AS vacant,
    round(100.0 * count(*) FILTER (WHERE occupied)::numeric / NULLIF(count(*), 0)::numeric, 2) AS occupancy_pct
   FROM state
  GROUP BY organization_id, property_id;

SELECT organization_id,
    sum(signed_amount) AS cash_on_hand
   FROM v_account_balances
  WHERE account_code = ANY (ARRAY['1110'::text, '1120'::text])
  GROUP BY organization_id;

SELECT organization_id,
    party_id AS tenant_id,
    allotment_id,
    sum(signed_amount) AS outstanding,
    max(entry_date) FILTER (WHERE debit > 0::numeric) AS last_charge_date,
    max(entry_date) FILTER (WHERE credit > 0::numeric) AS last_payment_date
   FROM v_account_balances
  WHERE account_code = '1200'::text AND party_kind = 'tenant'::party_kind

    sum(
        CASE

  WHERE account_type = ANY (ARRAY['INCOME'::account_type, 'EXPENSE'::account_type])

WITH p AS (
         SELECT v_account_balances.organization_id,
            date_trunc('month'::text, v_account_balances.entry_date::timestamp with time zone)::date AS month,
            v_account_balances.property_id,
            sum(v_account_balances.signed_amount) AS expenses
           FROM v_account_balances
          WHERE v_account_balances.account_type = 'EXPENSE'::account_type AND v_account_balances.property_id IS NOT NULL
          GROUP BY v_account_balances.organization_id, (date_trunc('month'::text, v_account_balances.entry_date::timestamp with time zone)::date), v_account_balances.property_id
        )
 SELECT organization_id,
    month,
    property_id,
    expenses,
    round(100.0 * expenses / NULLIF(sum(expenses) OVER (PARTITION BY organization_id, month), 0::numeric), 2) AS pct_of_org_expenses
   FROM p;

SELECT organization_id,
    property_id,
    date_trunc('month'::text, entry_date::timestamp with time zone)::date AS month,
    account_code,
    account_name,
    sum(signed_amount) AS revenue
   FROM v_account_balances
  WHERE account_type = 'INCOME'::account_type
  GROUP BY organization_id, property_id, (date_trunc('month'::text, entry_date::timestamp with time zone)::date), account_code, account_name;

WITH ar_charges AS (
         SELECT jl.organization_id,
            jl.party_id AS tenant_id,
            jl.allotment_id,
            je.entry_date AS charge_date,
            jl.debit - jl.credit AS net
           FROM journal_lines jl
             JOIN journal_entries je ON je.id = jl.journal_entry_id
             JOIN coa_accounts a ON a.id = jl.account_id
          WHERE a.code = '1200'::text AND jl.party_kind = 'tenant'::party_kind
        )
 SELECT organization_id,
    tenant_id,
    allotment_id,
    sum(
        CASE
            WHEN (CURRENT_DATE - charge_date) >= 0 AND (CURRENT_DATE - charge_date) <= 30 THEN net
            ELSE 0::numeric
        END) AS bucket_0_30,
    sum(
        CASE
            WHEN (CURRENT_DATE - charge_date) >= 31 AND (CURRENT_DATE - charge_date) <= 60 THEN net
            ELSE 0::numeric
        END) AS bucket_31_60,
    sum(
        CASE
            WHEN (CURRENT_DATE - charge_date) >= 61 AND (CURRENT_DATE - charge_date) <= 90 THEN net
            ELSE 0::numeric
        END) AS bucket_61_90,
    sum(
        CASE
            WHEN (CURRENT_DATE - charge_date) > 90 THEN net
            ELSE 0::numeric
        END) AS bucket_90_plus,
    sum(net) AS total
   FROM ar_charges
  GROUP BY organization_id, tenant_id, allotment_id;

SELECT jl.organization_id,
    jl.party_id AS tenant_id,
    jl.allotment_id,
    sum(
        CASE
            WHEN a.code = '1200'::text THEN jl.debit - jl.credit
            ELSE 0::numeric
        END) AS ar_balance,
    sum(
        CASE
            WHEN a.code = '2100'::text THEN jl.credit - jl.debit
            ELSE 0::numeric
        END) AS deposit_held,
    sum(
        CASE
            WHEN a.code = '2400'::text THEN jl.credit - jl.debit
            ELSE 0::numeric
        END) AS booking_advance,
    sum(
        CASE
            WHEN a.code = '1200'::text THEN jl.debit - jl.credit
            ELSE 0::numeric
        END) AS net_dues,
    max(je.entry_date) FILTER (WHERE a.code = '1200'::text AND jl.credit > 0::numeric) AS last_payment_date,
    max(je.entry_date) FILTER (WHERE a.code = '1200'::text AND jl.debit > 0::numeric) AS last_charge_date,
    count(*) FILTER (WHERE a.code = '1200'::text AND jl.debit > 0::numeric) AS charge_count,
    count(*) FILTER (WHERE a.code = '1200'::text AND jl.credit > 0::numeric) AS payment_count
   FROM journal_lines jl
     JOIN journal_entries je ON je.id = jl.journal_entry_id
     JOIN coa_accounts a ON a.id = jl.account_id
  WHERE jl.party_kind = 'tenant'::party_kind AND (a.code = ANY (ARRAY['1200'::text, '2100'::text, '2400'::text]))
  GROUP BY jl.organization_id, jl.party_id, jl.allotment_id;

SELECT je.organization_id,
    jl.party_id AS tenant_id,
    jl.allotment_id,
    je.entry_date,
    je.posted_at,
    je.id AS journal_entry_id,
    je.is_reversal_of,
    je.source_table,
    je.source_id,
    COALESCE(NULLIF(btrim(jl.memo), ''::text), je.description) AS description,
    a.code AS account_code,
    a.name AS account_name,
    jl.debit,
    jl.credit,
    sum(jl.debit - jl.credit) OVER (PARTITION BY je.organization_id, jl.party_id, jl.allotment_id, jl.account_id ORDER BY je.entry_date, je.posted_at, jl.line_no, jl.id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS running_balance,
    jl.memo,
    jl.property_id,
    jl.apartment_id,
    jl.bed_id
   FROM journal_lines jl
     JOIN journal_entries je ON je.id = jl.journal_entry_id
     JOIN coa_accounts a ON a.id = jl.account_id
  WHERE jl.party_kind = 'tenant'::party_kind AND (a.code = ANY (ARRAY['1200'::text, '2100'::text, '2400'::text]));

SELECT a.organization_id,

 SELECT a.organization_id,

    a.apartment_id,
    a.bed_id,
    a.tenant_id,
    a.id AS allotment_id,
    a.actual_exit_date AS event_date,

   FROM tenant_allotments a

SELECT organization_id,
    account_code,
    account_name,
    account_type,
    normal_balance,
    sum(debit) AS total_debit,
    sum(credit) AS total_credit,
    sum(debit) - sum(credit) AS balance
   FROM v_account_balances
  GROUP BY organization_id, account_code, account_name, account_type, normal_balance;

WITH RECURSIVE account_tree AS (
         SELECT a.id,
            a.organization_id,
            a.code,
            a.name,
            a.account_type,
            a.normal_balance,
            a.parent_id,
            a.is_active,
            a.code AS root_code,
            a.name AS root_name,
            0 AS depth
           FROM coa_accounts a
          WHERE a.parent_id IS NULL
        UNION ALL
         SELECT c.id,
            c.organization_id,
            c.code,
            c.name,
            c.account_type,
            c.normal_balance,
            c.parent_id,
            c.is_active,
            t_1.root_code,
            t_1.root_name,
            t_1.depth + 1
           FROM coa_accounts c
             JOIN account_tree t_1 ON t_1.id = c.parent_id
        ), account_balances AS (
         SELECT journal_lines.organization_id,
            journal_lines.account_id,
            sum(journal_lines.debit) AS total_debit,
            sum(journal_lines.credit) AS total_credit
           FROM journal_lines
          GROUP BY journal_lines.organization_id, journal_lines.account_id
        )
 SELECT t.organization_id,
    t.id AS account_id,
    t.code,
    t.name,
    t.account_type,
    t.normal_balance,
    t.parent_id,
    t.depth,
    t.root_code,
    t.root_name,
    COALESCE(ab.total_debit, 0::numeric) AS total_debit,
    COALESCE(ab.total_credit, 0::numeric) AS total_credit,
    COALESCE(ab.total_debit, 0::numeric) - COALESCE(ab.total_credit, 0::numeric) AS net_debit,
        CASE t.normal_balance
            WHEN 'DEBIT'::normal_balance THEN COALESCE(ab.total_debit, 0::numeric) - COALESCE(ab.total_credit, 0::numeric)
            ELSE COALESCE(ab.total_credit, 0::numeric) - COALESCE(ab.total_debit, 0::numeric)
        END AS balance,
    t.is_active
   FROM account_tree t
     LEFT JOIN account_balances ab ON ab.account_id = t.id AND ab.organization_id = t.organization_id;
